findings: Jev exposes bounded natural-language judgments as typed Choice, Noul, and Score data that code composes; code retains workflow and side-effect control.
Probability or distribution concentration is evidence for routing, not proof of correctness or permission to act; thresholds require target-domain validation.

Candidate-space completeness, an explicit no-match escape, decision-state binding, requested-versus-actual executor identity, and jaggedness failure classes are practical hardening inputs for existing CVF behavioral evaluation and routing owners.
Typed output guarantees an interface, not truth; arithmetic, date comparison, indirection, irrelevant context, adversarial content, and contradictory criteria remain named failure modes.

sourceAnomalies: Git LFS reported 68 tracked paths that should have been pointers but were materialized as ordinary files; selected Markdown capability paths were unaffected and readable.
findings: The workflow is an artifact dependency chain from locked brief through design truth, storyboard, bounded frame packets, assembly, verification, approval, and render.
A child is complete only when the expected artifact exists and verifies on disk; a harness completion notification is insufficient.
Concurrency limits reduce parallelism only; they must never drop, merge, or silently narrow required work.
Workers receive complete packets and exact write ownership, while integration claims are reserved for the assembly-level verifier.
The implementation separates immutable raw traces, persistent wiki knowledge, and active skills; the inference agent sees active skills but not the wiki.
Each iteration proposes one atomic skill change, accepts only strict validation improvement, restores only the active skill snapshot on rejection, and preserves the wiki and raw evidence.
The harness writes the proposal diff and accept/reject result to an impact ledger; self-reported agent success is not the decision authority.
Paired no-skill versus final-skill evaluation and explicit no-proposal or invalid-proposal records provide practical ASSF and Learning Plane evidence patterns.
